opening.argument: The video is centered on an entertainment-focused surprise: the speaker presents a friend with a Lamborghini and emphasizes, “It's yours. It's not Elise. It's completely yours.” The separate promotion is framed as an official collaboration, with the speaker stating, “I'm officially partnering with EA on their new game, Need For Speed Heat.” Its entry mechanism asks viewers to click a link and tweet a customized-car image, rather than provide payment, investment, credentials, or other financial participation: “So click the link below and tweet me a picture of your car to enter.” The video does not show the linked destination, contest administration, or fulfillment of the opportunity, so those matters remain outside what is established here.
